headline: South Korea to accelerate accession to CPTPP to seek economic vitality and counter protectionist challenges
summary: South Korea plans to accelerate its accession to the CPTPP to counter protectionist challenges. Trade accounts for about 75% of the economy's GDP, making it highly dependent on foreign trade.
why: CPTPP is a trade pact among Pacific-rim economies, and membership can lower tariffs and improve market access for exporters.
